title: India just launched a ship whose only job is keeping other warships at sea longer
sources: Free Press Journal, October 2026 - Rajnath Singh Launches India's First Indigenous Fleet Support Ship Surya In Rs 19,000 Crore Naval Push
ThePrint - Hindustan Shipyard delivers Surya, 1st of 5 logistics vessels to boost Navy's high-seas endurance
caption:
India just launched a ship whose only job is keeping other warships at sea longer. It's the first of its kind ever built in India.

On October 6, 2026, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched 'Surya,' India's first indigenously designed and built Fleet Support Ship, at Hindustan Shipyard Limited in Visakhapatnam - part of a Rs 19,000 crore, 5-ship program. At roughly 223 metres long and 43,500 tonnes, Surya lets warships refuel and resupply at sea, extending how long India's navy can stay deployed. The same event saw the keel laid for the program's fifth ship and a new 300-tonne Goliath crane inaugurated.

A warship fights. This one just makes sure the warships never have to come home early.
